scope: Frontend full owned source and backend combined isolated/HTTP/real-PostgreSQL instrumentation. See separate summary artifacts for exact denominators.
assessment: Coverage floors prevent regression; the repository does not yet have 100% coverage on every metric. This inventory discloses remaining paths, not an approved blanket exemption from the course rubric. All gaps are not claimed impossible to test.
location_note: Uncovered implicit else branches with empty locations use their enclosing branch location, marked parent_location_used. Locations come from V8/Istanbul source maps, not a claim every generated branch has independent business meaning.

unmeasured_boundaries: Live connected Supabase acceptance for this patch
